info.name: LearnHub API
info.description: LearnHub MERN LMS backend. Run npm run seed first, then set adminEmail and adminPassword to the values from backend/.env. Run the folders in order: Auth, Courses, Lessons, Enrollment, Admin. Login requests save the tokens automatically. The Admin folder deletes the created course and the registered Postman student; run npm run seed again to restore demo data.
